_matching: npc ids were matched by case-insensitive exact npcs.name equality against the cache database; the wiki does not publish cache ids. Matches with >1 distinct game_id are flagged match_ambiguous=true and are NOT narrowed by guessing.

_semantics.lifepoints/combat_level: the primary_variant's value, or null when the wiki offers several and none is canonical
_semantics.value_ambiguous: true when the wiki documents conflicting values and no single one was chosen
_semantics.status=no_value_recorded: fetch failed or page had no combat infobox
